cases.name: heading_comes_from_the_horizontal_axes
cases.note: A field along +x reads 0 degrees and along +y -90 (270); past the level gate a flat atan2 is not a heading, so a banked or a pitched airframe -- or no fresh field -- yields none.

cases.name: offset_is_learned_from_the_track_then_used_without_it
cases.note: The airframe tracks 90 degrees while the field reads 0: the offset learns 90. Then the GNSS drops and the yaw, wrong at 0, is pulled to field + offset with no track at all.

cases.name: an_unlearned_offset_never_steers
cases.note: With no track ever seen the offset is a zero that would claim magnetic north IS the track: a freely drifting gyro beats a confidently wrong pull, so yaw is left alone.

cases.name: the_track_wins_while_it_is_available
cases.note: Learned (one tracking call along the field), yaw at 90: while tracking the magnetometer is only measured, never steers -- two references fighting is worse than one.
